Jaia Colognese

Hi! I’m a cook and postpartum doula based in Berkeley, California.

I’ve been a professional cook for over five years. My roots in the kitchen began early when my parents transformed the garage of my childhood home into a wood-fired bakery. I spent a large part of my adolescence playing pretend-bakery in the front yard; eventually transitioning into working in the real shop in my early teens. I’m informed by the practices of meditation, Ashtanga yoga, writing, reading, and growing up watching my Italian parents and grandparents cook.

I became interested in birthwork when I stumbled upon black-and-white photos of a home birth taken in the early 1970s. This was one of my first experiences seeing birth depicted in a beautiful and empowering way. Through research and talking with birthing people and families, I began to understand that there is a need for more backing during this hugely transformative time. I offer easeful, non-judgmental support, bolstered by my experience as a professional cook.

Offerings

Weekly Meal Drop Off

Nourishing meals curated to your needs, available to anyone (not only postpartum). Using what’s in season in Northern California right now.

$70/hour, plus ingredients cost

For private chef services/events, send me an email.

Postpartum Support

Calm and compassionate support during the important postpartum phase; can include making a warm meal or snack, meal prep, light home organization, watching baby so you can rest, etc.

$75/hour, 4 hour minimum

If you have experienced pregnancy loss, whether unintentional or intentional, I can offer support with this process or the postpartum healing phase. Send me a message.

If cost is a barrier, please reach out. I try to offer sliding scale whenever possible. Let’s talk.
